prompt: Create a delicate vertical anime-style watercolor illustration of a serene young man seated on a wooden floor beside an open shoji-style window at dusk. He has misty blue-gray long, tousled hair braided over one shoulder, pale skin, soft half-closed eyes, and a calm introspective expression as he exhales smoke. Dress him in a loose traditional Japanese kimono: white inner robes, a deep indigo haori, and a dark sash, with flowing fabric folds pooling around his seated legs. He holds a slender kiseru-style smoking pipe horizontally in one raised hand near his mouth, with a thin ribbon of smoke drifting upward in a loose S curve. In the foreground, place exactly 1 round ceramic incense tray containing exactly 1 green spiral mosquito coil with exactly 1 glowing orange ember; a second translucent smoke ribbon rises from the coil and curls along the right side of the figure. The background should be mostly empty warm off-white paper, with exactly 1 dark wooden window frame on the right edge and a small glimpse of water, reeds, and a low orange sunset outside. Use airy ink linework, pale blue-gray washes, subtle beige shadows, visible sketch texture, soft negative space, and a quiet melancholic summer evening mood. Keep the composition tall and uncluttered, with the character occupying the lower-right center and large blank space above the smoke; no text, no watermark, no modern objects.

promptZh: 创作一幅精致的竖版水彩动漫插画，描绘一位宁静的中性化年轻人，身处传统的日式房间内，坐在日落时分敞开的窗边木地板上。角色拥有 柔和的蓝灰色 凌乱的齐肩发，留着一根长而松散的侧边辫子，皮肤白皙，五官精致优雅，双眼半闭，侧脸朝向左侧。他们身穿宽松的白色和服，外罩一件深靛蓝色羽织，衣褶飘逸，姿态放松地坐着，单膝抬起，衣物堆叠在周围。他们的右手水平握着一根细长的烟管（kiseru 风格）靠近嘴边，一缕淡淡的烟雾以优美的 S 形向上飘散。在右下角的前景中，包含一个圆形的香炉，其中放置一个绿色的螺旋蚊香，蚊香上有一个微小的橙色火星，升起第二缕半透明的卷曲烟雾。背景主要是留白的暖米白色纸张，右侧边缘有简单的深色木质窗框，窗外隐约可见远处的湖水和橙色的落日。采用轻盈的墨线勾勒，淡蓝灰色的渲染，微妙的米色阴影，可见类似铅笔的素描线条，运用大量的留白，营造出淡淡的忧郁氛围，且不含任何文字或水印。
